timer.clock_rule: Declare model ticks per RTL cycle before timing comparison. Do not infer it from retired instructions.

plic.reset: No pending source, priority, enable, claim or threshold state.

uart.contract: Implement byte registers, divisor latch, TX ready, RX FIFO, interrupt identification and reset. Capture TX output and version RX input events.

required_checks: Capture image, DTB, command line and adapter hashes before reset.
Reject payload overlap, BSS overlap, overflow and out-of-RAM placement.
Check timer and PLIC device state against independent expectations from round-2 device tests.
Check UART register behavior with an independent ns16550a oracle.
Compare selected live DTB properties on QEMU and RTL.
Check SBI timer, IPI, remote fence and hart-state functions separately.
Keep bounded startup instruction results separate from Linux userspace and RTL timing.
blockers: BOOM's interrupt generator at 0x0c000000 is not a PLIC. It conflicts with this map.
Current BOOM reset does not set Linux a0/a1. Current VexRiscv example is RV32IM.
No ns16550a RTL bus adapter is connected. Round-2 Timer and PLIC are reference models only.
RiscvSim payload loading alone does not implement this reset/device contract.

bounded_startup_fixture.qemu_check: generic ELF loader, no automatic payload or DTB edits
